eventMetadata.context_description: National Weather Service forecasts from San Francisco International Airport (KSFO) project a high of 71°F on May 15 under sunny skies with light westerly winds of 11-16 mph, fueling trader consensus at 73% implied probability for 66°F or higher. This warming trend stems from a building high-pressure ridge over California promoting subsidence and efficient burn-off of the typical marine layer—persistent cool, moist stratus from Pacific upwelling that often caps coastal highs. Recent observations show today's partly sunny high near 66°F after a cool early May with peaks in the upper 50s to low 60s, aligning with climatological norms around 66°F. Uncertainty lingers in forecast models over morning fog persistence, potentially limiting peaks to 64-65°F (26% odds); watch KSFO hourly data through afternoon for resolution.
